signature: DOUBLE PRECISION FUNCTION DLA_PORCOND( UPLO, N, A, LDA, AF, LDAF,

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of linear equations, i.e., the order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the N-by-N matrix A.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: AF
params.reference: The triangular factor U or L from the Cholesky factorization $A = U^T \, U$ or $A = L \, L^T$, as computed by DPOTRF.

params.name: ldaf
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AF`. $\mathrm{LDAF} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: cmode
params.reference:
Determines op2(C) in the formula op(A) \* op2(C) as follows:

| `CMODE =  1` | op2(C) = C |
| --- | --- |
| `CMODE =  0` | op2(C) = I |
| `CMODE = -1` | op2(C) = inv(C) |

params.name: c
params.reference: The vector C in the formula op(A) \* op2(C).

params.name: info
params.reference: -   `= 0`: Successful exit. $i > 0$:  The ith argument is invalid.
